prompt: Wide 16:9 hero artwork for Basement Show, an underground 1980s punk basement gig. Dim claustrophobic basement with low exposed ceiling beams, rough brick, hanging cables and scuffed concrete, no arena or big concert hall. Expressive simplified human shapes rather than polished realistic faces. Limited mostly monochrome palette with ONLY small pools of faded colored light at the distant stage. Camera at shoulder height inside the BACK of the crowd. Intimate, sweaty, loud and exuberant; black crowd mass remains the compositional focus, not bright lights.
